About Me

ML at scale,
AI with purpose

I'm a Machine Learning Engineer and AI Engineer with 3+ years of experience at Tata Consultancy Services, building scalable ML pipelines and backend systems for global banking clients — CTBC Bank (Taiwan) and ING Bank (Netherlands).

Currently pursuing an M.S. in Artificial Intelligence at Yeshiva University, Katz School (GPA: 3.8), with coursework in Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, and Generative AI.

I specialize in explainable AI, LLM agent orchestration, deep learning, and high-throughput data pipelines — with a focus on systems that are both performant and interpretable in regulated domains.
